description: This file defines the UserMigrationStatsDetail class, representing individual details of migration results in the context of SuiteCRM's calendar synchronization module. It includes properties such as type, user ID, user name, message, and optional event migration details, along with methods to set event migration details and produce a string representation.

classes.name: UserMigrationStatsDetail
classes.description: Represents individual migration result details within the SuiteCRM calendar synchronization migration process.

methods.name: setEventMigrationDetail
methods.description: Sets the event migration detail for this migration statistic detail.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the migration detail, including user info, message, type, and optional event details.
